# Plans and limits

Prices in US dollars a month; annual billing charges ten months for twelve. Enterprise is priced per customer. The API enforces every limit through the ability layer: a call past one is refused with `403` `plan_limit_reached`.

|  | Free | Basic | Professional | Enterprise |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Monthly price | $0 | $39 | $99 | custom |
| Extra seat, a month | not sold | $9 | $5 | custom |
| Projects | 1 | 2 | 5 | custom |
| Seats included | 1 | 5 | 15 | custom |
| Requests a month | 100 | 1,000 | 10,000 | custom |
| Knowledge documents | 20 | 100 | 500 | custom |
| URLs per crawl | 50 | 500 | 500 | custom |
| Screenshot storage | 500 MB | 5 GB | 25 GB | custom |
| AI credits included a month | 100 | 1,500 | 4,000 | custom |
| Credit overage | no | $3 per 100 | $3 per 100 | custom |
| Answers a month with your own AI key | 300 | unlimited | unlimited | unlimited |
| Platform answers per person a day | 10 | no daily limit | no daily limit | no daily limit |
| Widget logo and colours | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Custom strings | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Remove "Powered by Opem" | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Help centre custom address | no | yes | yes | yes |
| Management API and webhooks | knowledge sync on every plan; the rest Professional and Enterprise | knowledge sync on every plan; the rest Professional and Enterprise | yes | yes |
| Transcript retention, days | 7 | 30 | 90 | custom |
| Custom sending domain | no | no | no | yes |
| Single sign-on | no | no | no | yes |
| Support | community | email | priority email | dedicated |
